name: KTP (Indonesian ID Card)
llm_field_rules: nik: 16-digit numeric ID only (e.g. 3204051234560001). NEVER a person name.
name: full person name from the 'Nama' label.
birth_place: city/regency name from 'Tempat/Tgl Lahir' field, appearing BEFORE the date.
birth_date: date portion from 'Tempat/Tgl Lahir', format DD-MM-YYYY.
gender: LAKI-LAKI or PEREMPUAN. Found after 'Jenis Kelamin' label.
'Gol. Darah' / 'Gol Darah' is BLOOD TYPE — it is NOT a data field. IGNORE any value next to it.
address: street address from 'Alamat'. Does NOT include Gol. Darah.
rt_rw: two numbers separated by slash (e.g. 003/007).
marital_status: from 'Status Perkawinan' (e.g. KAWIN, BELUM KAWIN).

occupation: job title from 'Pekerjaan' label ONLY (e.g. PEGAWAI SWASTA, WIRASWASTA, GURU, DOKTER, BURUH). The bottom-right corner of KTP contains a city stamp and date (e.g. 'JAKARTA BARAT', '22-02-2017') — these are NOT part of the occupation. Stop at the first non-job word.
valid_until: from 'Berlaku Hingga' (e.g. SEUMUR HIDUP or a date).

CRITICAL — PRESERVE SPACES: Output every value EXACTLY as it appears, keeping ALL spaces between words. 'MIRA SETIAWAN' stays 'MIRA SETIAWAN'. 'JL. PASTI CEPAT A7/66' stays 'JL. PASTI CEPAT A7/66'. Never merge words.
Use null for any field not found in the OCR text.

llm_few_shot.input:
NIK : 3274081977032500
Nama : MIRA SETIAWAN
Tempat/Tgl Lahir : BANDUNG 05-03-1977
Jenis Kelamin : PEREMPUAN Gol. Darah : A
Alamat : JL. PASTI CEPAT NO 10
RT/RW : 003/007
Kel/Desa : SUKAMAJU
Kecamatan : BANDUNG
Agama : ISLAM
Status Perkawinan : KAWIN
Pekerjaan : PEGAWAI SWASTA BANDUNG 05-03-2020
Kewarganegaraan : WNI
Berlaku Hingga : SEUMUR HIDUP
